regions.merged_text: God bless you Mrs. Barden. Many thanks for your favor of the 6th -- your Son Rex's enrollment and the other poor sinner Solanus. Only when he gets to Heaven will he be fully converted. -- So keep on praying for him -- we'll pray for one another.
